conversation.Statement: This is Officer Daniel Myers from the IRS Criminal Investigation Division, badge ID 41762. Can I speak with Mr. Thomas Parker, please?
Yes, this is Tom Parker. What is this about?

Mr. Parker, I am contacting you regarding an urgent matter tied to your federal income taxes. According to our records, there are discrepancies with your filings from 2019 through 2022. Are you aware of this case?
No, I have no idea. I always file my taxes on time. What's going on?
Let me verify your information before discussing confidential details. Can you confirm your date of birth and the last four digits of your Social Security number?
Uh, my birthday is July 15, 1953. Last four are 2345.

Thank you, Mr. Parker. Based on your IRS case file 8709B, there is an outstanding federal tax liability of $3,984.62. This may be the result of misreported income or unclaimed assets. If not resolved, this will escalate to a criminal offense.
This can't be right... I'm on Social Security. My income is limited. I can't afford to owe that much.

Federal regulations require us to proceed. At this time, a warrant has been electronically issued for your arrest and will be executed within 24 hours if the matter is not settled. Your Social Security benefits are also subject to immediate suspension.
Wait, you're saying I could get arrested? And lose my benefits? Please, I can't have that happen.

Correct. Once processed, the arrest warrant cannot be revoked, and your bank accounts may be frozen under IRS Section 6331. However, you are eligible for a one-time resolution to avoid these penalties if payment is made immediately.
What am I supposed to do? I don't have that kind of money.

Mr. Parker, if you are unable to pay the full balance, the IRS accepts secure installment payments. For your protection, these must be processed through government-approved payment methods. Are you able to access your bank or a nearby store right now?
I guess I could go to the store. I don't know what else to do.

Good. For immediate compliance, you must purchase four Target or Best Buy gift cards for $500 each. These will be electronically registered as tax settlement vouchers. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store, as your case is confidential. Can you do this within the next hour?
I think so. So just buy the cards and then what?
Once you have the gift cards, remain on the line and read me the numbers on the back. This will allow us to secure your payment and immediately cancel the arrest warrant and benefit suspension.
Alright, I'll try. I just don't want to get into trouble or lose my Social Security.
You are cooperating, which is the right step. Do not disconnect. If you hang up, the system will assume you are evading federal authorities, and enforcement will proceed.
I understand. I'm getting ready to leave now. You'll wait?
Yes, I will remain on this secure line until you return. Once you have the gift cards, I will process your tax clearance.
